standard_prerequisites.use: Specialized to F = O_Z and G = O_W: the action of the module family of O_Z on the module family of O_W is the module family of the tensor product.

core_obligations: Show alpha cap beta = [Z x_Y W]_{r+e} for Z flat over Y (proof lines 2442-2445). This is a special case of lemma-action-coherent (tag 0H69) with F = O_Z and G = O_W: alpha = [Z/X/Y]_r is the module family of O_Z (example-family-associated-closed, tag 0H4S), beta = [W]_e is the module family of O_W (chow-definition-cycle-associated-to-closed-subscheme, tag 02QU), O_Z is flat over Y by hypothesis, and O_Z tensor_{O_X} f^* O_W is the structure sheaf of Z x_Y W, so the coherent action identity gives the claimed fibred product cycle (proof lines 2443-2444).
proof_roadmap: View alpha and beta as module families of the structure sheaves (statement lines 2435-2438).
Apply the coherent action lemma with F = O_Z, G = O_W and identify the tensor with the structure sheaf of the fibred product (proof lines 2443-2444).
